items.t: Raised Guidance Could Change The Case For Schrödinger Stock (SDGR)
items.sum: Schrödinger reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$64.49 million and a net loss of US$37.71 million, then raised full year 2026 guidance for annual contract value to a range of US$222 million to US$232 million and updated its drug discovery outlook to a range of US$75 million to US$85 million.
